nodes.label: Online-only authority
nodes.description: Backend connectivity, valid authorization and synchronization are prerequisites for gameplay. Disconnected views are stale/read-only; no local authority, queued offline commands or offline admission.
nodes.rationale: Approved durable-reconnect scope explicitly supersedes BR-016/D-005 offline-play wording; WebSockets alone do not satisfy offline play.

nodes.label: Role-filtered hibernating WSS
nodes.description: All roles receive first full authorized snapshot and ordered view-revision updates from Game Object; players only own boards, enrolled hosts/admins all allowed boards, spectators no private boards. Attachments are connection metadata, not durable board state.
nodes.rationale: Hibernation allows idle Objects to sleep without socket disconnection and reduces compute use. Fixed runtime heartbeats and durable deadlines must preserve expiry without always-running timers.

nodes.label: Commit-before-broadcast and command deduplication
nodes.description: Actor/game-scoped command ID durably stores accepted mutation, revision and result before acknowledgement/push. Call, all board effects and qualification form one logical change. Query/retry original ID after unknown outcome; broadcast failure never rolls back a commit.
nodes.rationale: Avoid duplicate random draws and inconsistent call-versus-board state under retries, crash and acknowledgement loss.

nodes.label: Recurring Free-plan hosting budget
nodes.description: No trials, paid upgrade or proven zero-cost production capacity. Documented planning guardrails: Worker 100000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/HTTP request, 128 MB/isolate; DO 100000 request-units/day, 13000 GB-seconds/day; SQLite 5 million rows read/day, 100000 written/day, 5 GB total. Direct assets free/unlimited. Recheck before release.
nodes.rationale: Worker and DO budgets are distinct and one operation may consume both; retained History, admission, board generation, fan-out and reconnect load all require headroom.

nodes.label: Single-use access-link enrollment
nodes.description: CLI or authorized admin durably provisions verifier before privately returning a one-day single-use HTTPS link. Atomic consume plus restricted one-day session; mandatory password setup rotates credential while preserving original deadline. Later login uses chosen password.
nodes.rationale: Replaces only the generated initial password, not later password authentication; lost redemption response cannot make a consumed token reusable.

nodes.label: Per-game capacity limits
nodes.description: Independent player default/hard ceiling 20, integer range 2-20; spectator default/hard ceiling 50, range 0-50. Backend counts memberships not sockets; New-only designated-host/admin edits. Zero spectators disables admission, not start.
nodes.rationale: Product admission ceilings are separate from Cloudflare quotas and cannot establish safe measured load.

nodes.label: Snapshot-first reconnection
nodes.description: Gap-free snapshot/subscription ordering, full authorized snapshot on every reconnect, base/result view revisions, foreground/periodic repair and obsolete-socket discard. Connecting/Synchronizing/Live/Reconnecting with jittered backoff capped at 30 seconds. One live connection per participant session.
nodes.rationale: Fresh durable snapshots repair missed broadcasts and matches without a replay archive, client mark replay or board regeneration; heartbeat success proves neither authorization nor freshness.

nodes.label: Fixed one-day role-bound sessions
nodes.description: Opaque backend-issued Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies with fixed one-day absolute expiry, distinct enrollment/account/player/spectator bindings and revocation. No sliding renewal, localStorage tokens or access extension from retained seats; enforce expiry on live/hibernating sockets.
nodes.rationale: Stable game/member identity plus server-held bindings prevent code/alias reuse or client flags from conferring authority.

nodes.label: Brews-answer player recovery
nodes.description: Optional private salted nonreversible verifier; only code plus remembered current alias plus matching enrolled answer recovers an existing Awaiting Players/In Progress membership. Atomically replace prior tokens/sockets with a fresh one-day session. No board generation, role/seat change, alias lookup or host/admin fallback. Valid-session owners may set/replace/delete answer; delete on spectator switch/terminal.
nodes.rationale: Convenience proof is weak and guessable, not strong identity or host-password recovery. Skipping is allowed but loses lost-session recovery; hashes/rate limits do not make predictable answers strong.

nodes.label: Host-mediated single-winner award
nodes.description: Real-life Bingo/alias judged by host; designated host or enrolled admin submits exactly one qualified same-game member. Backend acceptance atomically freezes winner/result as Resolved. Offline/departed qualifying players remain eligible. Pool exhaustion/qualification alone never resolve.
nodes.rationale: Separate qualification from human first-caller judgment and final award; no automatic tie-break, microphone detection, second winner or outcome rewrite.

nodes.label: Pattern-specific Rust traits
nodes.description: Each distinct winning pattern has its own Rust trait boundary in provider-independent shared/domain. Single Line is the only specified pattern; row/column/diagonal are orientations, not separate modes.
nodes.rationale: Keep rule evaluation independent of networking, host permissions, human Bingo timing and winner selection; any LLD orchestration must not replace separate pattern traits with only a generic trait.

nodes.label: Automatic call matching
nodes.description: Authorized random/manual call validates In Progress, pool membership and nonduplication. Match every board, including offline/departed players; evaluate Single Line and durably commit call/boards/flags/revision/result before WSS. Rejections and accepted retries have no duplicate effects.
nodes.rationale: Backend accepted state, not clicks, socket delivery or player acknowledgements, determines matches and qualification.

nodes.label: Game lifecycle
nodes.description: Exactly New, Awaiting Players, In Progress, Resolved and Cancelled; no sixth closed state. Winner path progresses to Resolved; cancellation/no-winner ending goes to Cancelled. Configuration freezes in Awaiting Players.
nodes.rationale: Exit changes access/navigation, not terminal gameplay; obsolete four-state/no-winner-Resolved wording is superseded.

nodes.label: Terminal immutability and independent Exit
nodes.description: Resolved/Cancelled forbid calls, board generation/reassignment, matching, rule/outcome edits, reopening and new admission. Exit only updates access/navigation; no second Close and no wait for viewers. After exit hosts use History, not game re-entry. Player final restoration ends at Exit/original expiry; spectator cleanup is stricter.
nodes.rationale: Durable terminal outcome releases global reservation independently from final viewers; scheduled expiry is deletion, not a mutable outcome.

nodes.label: Read-only final History
nodes.description: Started games ending Resolved or Cancelled retain ordered called strings, participating aliases, optional winning alias and one self-contained final board snapshot per player, including free cells/matches. All enrolled hosts/admins may read; no replay timeline, credentials, recovery authority or initial-release export.
nodes.rationale: Final snapshots must stand alone rather than depend on live membership/session records; pre-start cancellations have no History.

nodes.label: Three-month History expiry
nodes.description: Fixed three calendar months from first durable started-game terminal transition; no silent 90-day substitution or renewal on reads/exits/retries. Deny at expiry and durably schedule/retry deletion without visits across record/indexes/caches/backups/restores. No separate one-week player-data TTL.
nodes.rationale: Retention is distinct from access/session validity; copies and restore operations must not extend or resurrect expired History.

nodes.label: Connected-player start gate
nodes.description: Explicit designated-host/admin start requires fixed valid rules, continuing global-slot ownership, feasible position-distinct boards and at least two distinct currently connected players with valid sessions. All retained roster members, including disconnected players, receive boards. Spectators/duplicate sockets never count.
nodes.rationale: Separates connection eligibility from retained roster membership; rejects infeasible starts rather than accepting duplicate boards or unlimited regeneration.

nodes.label: Random distinct board generation
nodes.description: Generate/assign immediately after accepted start, never join/recovery. Sample non-free cells from valid string pool without within-board repeats or row/column restrictions; regenerate cell-for-cell duplicates across players. Same values in different positions are distinct. Check feasibility before Start; assignments/flags persist before first call.
nodes.rationale: Position-sensitive uniqueness avoids identical player layouts without requiring globally disjoint values; reject infeasible settings instead of relying on unbounded retries.

nodes.label: Configurable free cells
nodes.description: Checkbox defaults true; one-based default cell (ceil(height/2), ceil(width/2)) for every supported size. Host may disable or choose up to all cells before rules freeze. Free cells have no pool values, satisfy matching at assignment and may immediately qualify. All-free fails minimum-two-player distinct-board feasibility.
nodes.rationale: Qualification is not an award; unrestricted free-cell count is preserved while distinct-board feasibility independently constrains Start.

nodes.label: Pre-start cancellation and idle cleanup
nodes.description: Confirmed manual New/Awaiting Players cancellation or 24 hours without qualifying designated-host activity commits Cancelled, then deletes game/participant data and safely releases slot, with no History or board generation. Notices/independent exits do not gate cleanup.
nodes.rationale: Only authenticated host open/resume/accepted actions reset idle deadline, not background traffic or other users; timer never ends In Progress.

nodes.label: Membership and connection retention
nodes.description: Pre-start player disconnect keeps alias/seat until start/cancel; explicit Leave releases them. In Progress Leave/disconnect retains board and award eligibility, permits valid-session/answer return. Spectator disconnect grants five-minute seat grace, intentional Leave releases immediately. One connection per participant session; pre-start role switching atomically observes target capacity.
nodes.rationale: Connection/socket count, membership retention, session expiry and intentional terminal Exit are separate; none silently grants renewed credentials.

nodes.label: Spectator terminal and seat cleanup
nodes.description: At explicit seat release, grace expiry or terminal end delete spectator identity/session data. Deliver terminal result to connected spectators then leave only local view until Exit; no terminal reconnect/refresh fetch even before Exit.
nodes.rationale: Supersedes earlier generic pre-exit spectator final-view restoration; failed delivery must not retain spectator data indefinitely.

nodes.label: Game code
nodes.description: Exactly eight random uppercase ASCII A-Z/0-9 characters, case-insensitive lookup with outer ASCII-space trim and no internal spaces. Issued in Awaiting Players, stable until terminal; unknown codes never create games. Collision checks cover live games and unexpired History; later reuse cannot transfer old credentials.
nodes.rationale: Code discovers stable game identity; it is not host/admin access or proof of existing-player ownership.

nodes.label: Confirmed designated-host transfer
nodes.description: Designated host or admin selects another fully enrolled host/admin and confirms; backend commits immediately with no recipient acceptance. Ownership changes, game data/reservations do not. Outgoing host retains read-only board access; admin overrides persist.
nodes.rationale: Viewing, disconnection or an admin action alone never transfers ownership; recheck current committed authority when concurrent actions execute.

nodes.label: Privileged account management
nodes.description: CLI/enrolled admins provision and manage enrollment/reset links. Reset revokes target sessions/sockets and blocks old login until setup; pending reissue invalidates old links/restricted sessions without duplicating account. Disable/delete blocked while target hosts nonterminal game.
nodes.rationale: Admin app management supersedes earlier developer-exclusive wording without distributing cloud credentials or granting ordinary hosts provisioning rights.

nodes.label: Player terminal credential cleanup
nodes.description: Delete answer verifiers at terminal; started-game players keep only minimal existing-session/exit authorization until Exit or original one-day expiry. No new terminal recovery. Pre-start cancellation deletes participant data; History retains final aliases/boards separately.
nodes.rationale: Operational credentials must not become History content or extend final-view access.

nodes.label: Single nonterminal-game reservation
nodes.description: At most one New/Awaiting Players/In Progress game application-wide. Claim at New creation, retain at start, commit terminal state before retry-safe owner-specific release. Never release on disconnection/exit or let stale retries release a newer owner.
nodes.rationale: HLD-077 supersedes the former separate unstarted and In-Progress slots; Directory/Game coordination is not a cross-Object transaction.

nodes.label: Privileged account enable
nodes.description: Required API/app and CLI enable functionality: another enrolled admin or developer CLI only, never self-enable. Derive disabled status exclusively from populated disabled_at; disable sets timestamp, enable clears it while retaining Verified/PendingEnrollment/ResetRequired lifecycle. No duplicate boolean or previous-status copy.
nodes.rationale: Re-enable restores prior lifecycle, not revoked credentials: Verified permits fresh password login; pending/reset still need fresh links/setup. Never role-upgrade or recreate deleted account.

nodes.label: Deferred detailed design
nodes.description: Account-store placement, schemas, transaction ownership, cross-Object coordination, protocol fields, crate versions, hash/password policy, cleanup, UI/accessibility/announcements and quality/browser matrices remain unselected. Native packaging is later work.

nodes.label: Quota exhaustion and unavailable operation
nodes.description: Affected free-tier operations may fail on allowance exhaustion. Surface unavailable/failed writes, disable gameplay and never acknowledge an uncommitted mutation or silently upgrade to paid service.
nodes.rationale: Free-hosting selection is a budget boundary, not an availability guarantee or a measured attendance guarantee.

nodes.label: Awaiting Players
nodes.description: After valid configuration/code publication, rules and limits are fixed. Player/spectator admission and saved lobby resume; no boards. Cannot return to New/edit rules. Explicit eligible Start or cancellation only.

nodes.label: Cancelled
nodes.description: All final no-winner outcomes: New/Awaiting Players cancellation or confirmed manual ending in In Progress. Immutable. Pre-start data deleted without History; started-game final History retained.

nodes.label: Rust Worker
nodes.description: Backend entrypoint performs access checks and routing: discovery/global coordination to Directory, gameplay to the owning Game Durable Object. Managed Wasm server components, not a native VM/container process.

nodes.label: Backend security and privacy controls
nodes.description: Backend validation/authorization on commands, upgrades and delivery; Origin/CSRF protection, safe alias rendering, parameterized storage, verifier-only secrets, log redaction, bounded abuse controls and private-cache clearing. Password policy, algorithms and thresholds deferred.
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly is not CSRF protection; random codes are not authentication, and predictable Brews answers remain weak proof despite hashing/rate limits.

nodes.label: New
nodes.description: Creation claims sole global slot and assigns creator as designated host. Rules and capacities editable; no join code/admitted players/boards. Confirmed cancellation or 24-hour host-idle timeout commits Cancelled.

nodes.label: Developer-only CLI
nodes.description: Developer operational provisioning and account-management path using privileged Cloudflare environment credentials. First-admin bootstrap must use CLI; language, commands and access mechanism remain unselected.
nodes.rationale: Cloud credentials remain in controlled developer/server environments, never browser builds; admins use backend-authorized app APIs, not the credential-bearing CLI.

nodes.label: SQLite-backed Durable Object storage
nodes.description: Each owning Object has strongly consistent transactional storage. Boards and accepted changes persist independently of process/socket lifetime; no cross-Object transaction is assumed.

nodes.label: Admin-only Users view
nodes.description: Enrolled admins list provisioned host/admin accounts; backend denies others, not just hidden navigation. Anonymous memberships not listed; no secrets. Columns, pagination and layouts remain LLD/UI.

nodes.label: HTTPS
nodes.description: Enrollment, login/setup, admission, recovery, commands, command-result lookup and History use HTTPS; recovery answers only in protected bodies, never URLs or socket messages.

nodes.label: Square board and string-pool configuration
nodes.description: Equal integer sides 2-10 inclusive, default 5×5; values are strings, initially numeric 1 through host-defined upper bound default 75. Validate sufficient distinct pool for non-free cells before Awaiting Players. Configuration frozen thereafter.

nodes.label: Planning approval boundary
nodes.description: Formal HLD sign-off, detailed technical design and implementation authorization are separate unfinished gates. Listed tests, folder layouts and architecture are not implementation evidence.
nodes.rationale: Preserve staged review and prevent approved architectural direction from being mistaken for permission to scaffold, provision or deploy.

nodes.label: Release verification gates
nodes.description: Future tests/load evidence for Rust/Wasm/SDK integration, hibernation, full 20-player plus 50-spectator populations, CPU/storage/quota headroom, race/retry/commit failures, session/privacy boundaries, cleanup/backups and browser compatibility. Latency/capacity targets and procedures still TBD.
nodes.rationale: Documented HLD decisions and planned tests do not establish working software, proven free-tier capacity or release readiness.

nodes.label: Player

nodes.description: **Confirmed capability and actor restriction (HLD-078; DO-022 clarification):** Enable an existing disabled host/admin account only when the caller is a different fully enrolled admin account with valid authority, or the developer using the separately privileged CLI path. Enforce caller-account ID != target-account ID for app-admin calls; ordinary hosts, participants, unauthenticated callers and the disabled target itself cannot enable it. This is not role editing, deleted-account restoration or automatic revival of revoked/expired credentials. **Approved outcome:** clear the authoritative `disabled_at` timestamp while preserving the existing lifecycle `status`. No disabled boolean is stored. Previously Verified accounts may log in afresh with their existing password; PendingEnrollment still needs setup, and ResetRequired still needs reset. Do not revive old sessions/links. Pending setup/reset requires a newly issued link through the existing flow. Clear `disabled_at` on the accepted enable transition; an authorized already-enabled retry is a no-op without timestamp changes. DO-022 approves lifecycle, timestamp-derived disablement and credential-epoch semantics; transaction/concurrency and cross-Object delivery remain TBD. The approved HLD-078/DO-022 outcome and different-admin/CLI restriction do not approve the proposed route, transaction mechanics or response schema.

nodes.description: A valid spectator session is required. Immediately release that spectator’s occupancy and delete its identity/session data. Explicit Leave does not receive accidental-disconnect grace. Dispatch using server-verified role and lifecycle.

nodes.label: recover_player_session
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Verify submitted code, current alias and enrolled answer; replace old sessions/sockets and restore the same nonterminal membership/board without another seat. nodes.label: manage_my_recovery_answer
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Set/replace the caller’s answer using PUT or delete it using DELETE in Awaiting Players/In Progress. Deletion disables answer recovery. A lost-session caller cannot use this operation to establish ownership.

nodes.label: join_game_as_player
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: In Awaiting Players, validate the code-based admission context, alias and capacity; claim alias/seat, create membership and optional answer verifier, and issue a player session. No board is generated yet.

nodes.label: join_game_as_spectator
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Validate the code-based admission context and Awaiting Players/In Progress capacity; allocate spectator identity/seat and issue its session. No player or account privileges are granted.

nodes.label: rename_my_alias
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: switch_to_spectator
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Before start, acquire spectator admission, release player seat/alias and delete the player recovery verifier. Failure preserves the original role.

nodes.label: switch_to_player
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: A valid existing spectator session is required. Before start, claim an eligible player seat/alias, release spectator occupancy and optionally enroll a fresh answer. Do not restore deleted credentials or permit an unauthenticated membership takeover.

nodes.label: cancel_unstarted_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: With designated-host/admin confirmation, commit Cancelled from New/Awaiting Players, then apply notice and no-History deletion rules. Generate no boards. Confirmation must remain bound to pre-start state; a delayed confirmation must not select the In Progress cancellation branch.

nodes.label: end_game_without_winner
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: With designated-host/admin confirmation, commit Cancelled from In Progress, retain final History and safely release the live reservation. The current game state determines this branch rather than the pre-start cancellation branch.

nodes.label: start_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: The designated host or an authorized admin validates the connected-player minimum, that this game still owns the single global nonterminal-game reservation, and board feasibility; transitions this same game to In Progress and persists boards/initial qualification for the retained start roster. Accepted retries preserve original assignments; free-cell qualification never automatically awards a winner.

nodes.label: call_random_value
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: The designated host or an authorized admin requests a random undrawn value. Persist the call, matching board changes, qualification, revision and command outcome consistently before delivery. An accepted retry returns the same committed random value; pool exhaustion does not end the game.

nodes.label: call_manual_value
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: The designated host or an authorized admin submits a string value. Validate pool membership/nonduplication and perform the same durable progression as a random call. String input belongs to pool and must be undrawn; rejected calls apply no partial matching.

nodes.label: award_game_winner
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: exit_game_result
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Requires the caller’s existing final-view authorization when a server-side exit record is needed. Clean up only that caller’s access without changing outcomes, logging accounts out or waiting for others. Spectator local-only Exit requires no request after server data deletion. Local spectator/pre-start-deleted view exit needs no surviving session; account authentication and other viewers remain unchanged.

nodes.label: execute_command_idempotently
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

Return an existing committed result or safely complete the original command without duplicate calls, boards, awards or admissions. The initiating client retains the original endpoint’s scope. Secret-bearing issuance needs a separate handoff/retry policy; no token/link in secret-free receipts.

nodes.label: purge_expired_history
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Reconcile interrupted directory/game/account operations without duplicate effects, invalid publication, incorrect reservation release or resurrected data. PendingOperation/protocol arguments are proposed trusted persisted work; recovery variants and scheduling remain TBD.

nodes.label: record_admin_action
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Record the actual admin actor, target, operation and result without secrets. Audit storage, retention and any administrative read interface remain TBD. Audit storage/retention/read interface and failure policy remain TBD; no public audit endpoint or hidden History archive.

nodes.label: coordinate_global_game_reservation
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Coordinate the one global nonterminal-game reservation. Claim it on New creation, retain it through Awaiting Players and In Progress, and release it only after committed Resolved/Cancelled. A stale operation must never release a newer game’s reservation. nodes.label: update_participant_presence
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: expire_spectator_grace
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: expire_or_revoke_credentials
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: cancel_idle_unstarted_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: purge_cancelled_unstarted_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: finalize_game_retention
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Preserve started-game final History; delete recovery verifiers and spectator server data; retain only permitted minimal player final-view authorization.

nodes.label: get_current_session
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Resolve the presented session and return its safe identity, scope, expiry and current permissions. Missing or invalid credentials do not disclose another identity or grant access. Never return credential verifiers.

nodes.label: list_users
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: get_user
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: list_games
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: get_current_nonterminal_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: resolve_game_code
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Normalize and resolve an issued code to an existing game and limited entry information. Unknown codes never create games; discovery grants no membership, private data or gameplay permissions.

nodes.label: get_game
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Read only the caller-authorized game/configuration projection. Host/admin accounts and admitted player/spectator sessions receive their permitted fields. A game ID alone does not authorize private data or unrestricted game inspection.

nodes.label: get_my_membership
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: list_game_players
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Read player aliases and permitted membership/presence information. Distinguish retained disconnected players from currently connected players.

nodes.label: get_game_availability
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: is_alias_claimed
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.

nodes.label: get_game_calls
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Return the most recent value and committed call sequence to authorized game viewers, including admitted spectators. A valid account or participant access context is required; knowing the game ID alone is insufficient.

nodes.label: get_remaining_values
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Derive/read the remaining pool and exhaustion state from configuration and accepted calls for the host/admin operating or inspection view. Audience-facing exhaustion status can be included in the permitted game snapshot without exposing this full query.

nodes.label: get_my_board
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Read the caller’s assigned layout, free cells, automatic matches and qualification. No board exists before start.

nodes.label: get_game_boards
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Inspect all or selected player boards read-only. Selection/filter details remain TBD; designated-host ownership is not required for inspection.

nodes.label: get_game_qualification
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Hosts/admins receive qualifying players; players receive only their own qualification. Spectators receive no private qualifier details.

nodes.label: get_game_result
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Return only a permitted final view. Players need existing unexpired, not-exited authorization; hosts/admins must satisfy their final-view access rules and use History after exit. Spectators cannot fetch/reconnect after terminal cleanup.

nodes.label: list_game_history
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: List unexpired started-game History across hosts. Exclude pre-start cancellations and expired records. Query options remain TBD.

nodes.label: get_game_history
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Read final ordered calls, aliases, winner if any and final board snapshots. No replay archive, credentials, membership restoration or mutation.

nodes.label: send_game_update
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Push already-committed, role-filtered changes to currently authorized recipients. This is server delivery, not a user-invoked HTTP request or gameplay mutation.

nodes.label: synchronize_game_view
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Requires valid access to the requested game/view. Compare the client’s authorized-view revision and return fresh state when needed. Do not treat private updates as public gaps, renew credentials or bypass exit restrictions.

nodes.label: get_command_result
nodes.contract_status: Final route/signature, schemas, requiredness, encodings, statuses and protocol details remain TBD; stated confirmed domain/security guards still apply.
nodes.description: Requires valid authority for the original actor/game-scoped command. Read its durable outcome after an interrupted response without exposing another actor’s results. Knowledge of a command ID is not authorization. Missing receipt does not prove effects may safely be repeated; result access and retention remain bounded.

nodes.label: find_hosted_nonterminal_games

nodes.description: While the target account’s Directory gate is held, find nonterminal games by designated-host account ID for disable/delete. A stale empty index is not sufficient to remove the account; assignment freshness/serialization remain under review. This does not expose Users to ordinary hosts. Presence-only gate does not store operation_id. A stale empty host index is insufficient removal authority; serialization remains TBD.

nodes.label: Authorized-view revisions

nodes.label: Hibernation-safe socket authorization

nodes.rationale: Sleeping/restarted Objects and stale sockets must not extend session lifetime or deliver unauthorized state.

nodes.label: Safe transport error mapping

nodes.rationale: Existing code permits spectators in Awaiting Players and mid-game In Progress within their separate capacity. Spectators never gate start through count/presence/readiness/connection and never count as players. No player board or host authority. Resolved or Cancelled permits no new joins; existing viewers may see final state then exit without return. Implementation remains LLD (Sections 2–10, especially 7.5).

nodes.label: HLD-017 Role choice, aliases and state-based admission
nodes.norm_label: hld-017 role choice, aliases and state-based admission
nodes.rationale: Awaiting Players offers player/spectator; player needs valid available alias/slot and may enroll Brews answer. In Progress admits only new spectators, never players/promotions. Valid sessions reconnect; code + remembered current alias + matching enrolled answer replaces a lost session for existing membership. HLD-030 sets alias limits/reuse; HLD-031 excludes fallbacks. Resolved or Cancelled denies new/recovery admission and post-exit return. HLD-053–HLD-055 fix same-game alias release/rejoining; comparison/characters/spaces/counting and pre-start rename/current-alias recovery are fixed by HLD-049–HLD-052; HLD-045 permits pre-start switching in either direction within target capacity (Sections 2–10).

nodes.label: HLD-018 Configurable player and spectator limits with hard maxima
nodes.norm_label: hld-018 configurable player and spectator limits with hard maxima
nodes.rationale: Per-game configurable limits cannot exceed **20 players** or **50 audience spectators**, enforced by the backend and not defaults/account-wide quotas. Admission/retry safety prevents duplicate/excess occupancy. HLD-020 fixes transient-disconnect retention; player default is 20 (HLD-046); spectator default is 50 (HLD-046); HLD-047 fixes integer player range 2–20 and spectator range 0–50 (zero disables spectating); HLD-048 restricts designated-host edits to New and freezes both limits after that; constant locations remain LLD; HLD-041/HLD-042/HLD-044 settle explicit departures. No measured capacity claimed (Sections 2–11).

nodes.label: HLD-020 Durable WSS recovery and online-only gameplay
nodes.norm_label: hld-020 durable wss recovery and online-only gameplay
nodes.rationale: Directory + per-game SQLite Objects, all-role WSS/HTTPS, full snapshots, revisions/deduplication, capped 30-second retries, retained In Progress player membership, five-minute spectator grace and one live socket per participant session. HLD-027/HLD-028 restrict terminal continuity to existing valid pre-exit final views; no Resolved or Cancelled readmission/reopening. Host History is separate. No offline actions/authority; old BR-016/D-005 wording requires separate reconciliation (Sections 3–12).

nodes.label: HLD-021 Single-use access URLs and one-day role-bound sessions
nodes.norm_label: hld-021 single-use access urls and one-day role-bound sessions
nodes.rationale: CLI provisioning persists a one-day enrollment access-token verifier and returns its HTTPS URL. Backend atomically validates/consumes it and issues a one-day restricted HttpOnly cookie session; password setup stays mandatory, later login uses password. All sessions have fixed one-day TTL, enforced server-side including open WSS. Players bind to game code + alias/stable membership; hosts to account; spectators to game/identity. No reconnect renewal or alias-only ownership. HLD-022 separately authorizes verified answer-based replacement of a lost player session with a fresh one-day session; concrete protocols remain LLD (Sections 5–9.4).

nodes.label: HLD-022 Optional Brews-answer player-session recovery
nodes.rationale: Optional private answer enrollment; code + remembered current alias + matching enrolled answer restores the same membership in Awaiting Players/In Progress: no board before host start, same assigned board afterward (HLD-034). Atomically issue a fresh one-day HttpOnly session and invalidate prior game/alias tokens/sockets; no additional slot, player or role privilege. HLD-031 explicitly excludes alternatives and forgotten-alias lookup. Resolved or Cancelled recovery is prohibited. Matching/abuse/security/authorized-user answer-change and cleanup mechanics remain LLD/review; HLD-032 defines final-board History under a common three-month TTL, excluding recovery/session credentials (Section 9.4).

nodes.label: HLD-023 Pattern-specific Rust traits and Single Line qualification
nodes.norm_label: hld-023 pattern-specific rust traits and single line qualification
nodes.rationale: Each distinct pattern has its own Rust trait boundary; initially only Single Line: a full row, column or either full diagonal on a square board. Evaluate at initial assignment (including free-cell-only lines) and after server-side automatic matches from accepted host calls, then flag qualifiers to host/own-player screens; no manual marking or digital player claim. Trait signatures/algorithms belong in LLD; HLD-033 settles random generation without per-board repeated values; generation/assignment follow HLD-034; free-cell behavior is fixed by HLD-035 (Sections 4–7, 10; HLD-025, HLD-026).

nodes.label: HLD-024 One host-selected winner and final result
nodes.norm_label: hld-024 one host-selected winner and final result
nodes.rationale: Real-life Bingo/alias exchange, host selects one qualified first caller and submits, backend validates/persists one winner. No digital claim, audio detection, automatic tie-break or second winner. **HLD-027/HLD-028 replace the former post-winner active reservation and later Close step:** accepted winner submission directly commits Resolved and safely releases the sole global nonterminal-game reservation; exit is independent and later host inspection is History-only. Confirmed manual end terminates as Cancelled without a winner (HLD-037) (Sections 2–10, especially 7.7).

nodes.label: HLD-025 Square board sizes and default
nodes.norm_label: hld-025 square board sizes and default
nodes.rationale: Width and height must be equal integer side lengths **2 through 10 inclusive**, default `5 × 5`. Reject non-square/out-of-range configuration and validate enough distinct pool values for the non-free cells before Awaiting Players. Single Line uses complete rows/columns or either full corner-to-corner diagonal. HLD-033–HLD-035 define generation, assignment and free-cell behavior; exact representation/algorithms remain LLD (Sections 2, 5–7, 10; BR-029/D-001 refinement).

nodes.label: HLD-026 Automatic matching and durable per-player boards
nodes.norm_label: hld-026 automatic matching and durable per-player boards
nodes.rationale: Players never mark/unmark. Every accepted host call (random or valid manual value) automatically updates matching cells across all boards in that game, including disconnected players, then evaluates qualification. Persist each board’s layout/values and matched state in the existing per-game SQLite-backed Durable Object, with call/revision/result consistency before role-filtered WSS push. Restore the same board and missed matches on reconnect; reject client edits and stop new call effects after winner submission. No per-board Object, new database or implementation is introduced. Random generation from the valid pool without repeated values within a board is confirmed (HLD-033); generation/assignment timing is settled by HLD-034; default free-cell placement on even-sized boards is fixed by HLD-035; concrete mechanics belong in LLD (Sections 4–10, especially 6.2).

nodes.label: HLD-027 Final Resolved outcome, independent exits and History-only return
nodes.norm_label: hld-027 final resolved outcome, independent exits and history-only return
nodes.rationale: Winner acceptance commits immutable Resolved; no more calls/cards/marks/outcome edits. Safely release reservation, allow independent exits and host new-game creation after leaving. No post-exit game return. Later host inspection is only the minimal History retained under HLD-032, not full operational snapshots. Supersedes a second Close/held reservation. TTL deletion is not reopening or outcome editing (Sections 6.3, 7.7).

nodes.label: HLD-028 Original lifecycle values and manual no-winner ending
nodes.norm_label: hld-028 original lifecycle values and manual no-winner ending
nodes.rationale: New, Awaiting Players and In Progress retain their meanings. Earlier four-state/no-winner-Resolved wording is superseded: winner submission commits Resolved; host cancellation or confirmed manual no-winner end commits Cancelled. Dismissing the end-confirmation prompt leaves In Progress unchanged. Five exact states now apply; no post-terminal gameplay/reopening (Sections 5–8; HLD-036/HLD-037).

nodes.label: HLD-029 Cross-host game and History visibility
nodes.norm_label: hld-029 cross-host game and history visibility
nodes.rationale: Hosts can view games hosted by other hosts and unexpired final History: announced cards, participating/winning aliases and each final board snapshot under HLD-032. No intermediate-board archive, player-session ownership, recovery material, handoff/mutation or reopening rights. HLD-062 permits read-only private live-board/qualification access for all fully enrolled hosts (Sections 4–10).

nodes.label: HLD-030 Player alias length, character categories and reuse
nodes.norm_label: hld-030 player alias length, character categories and reuse
nodes.rationale: Required alias up to **20 characters**, permitting **letters of either case, numbers and standard special characters**. Unique within a game; **reusable across different games** with independent identity/board/answer/session state. HLD-049–HLD-052 fix case-insensitive ASCII-only comparison, space normalization/post-trim counting and pre-start rename/current-alias recovery; HLD-053–HLD-055 fix same-game reuse/rejoining. Enforce validation server-side, escape display and preserve punctuation safely (Sections 2, 4–10).

nodes.label: HLD-031 No alternate player recovery; replacement invalidates old session
nodes.norm_label: hld-031 no alternate player recovery; replacement invalidates old session
nodes.rationale: Only **game code + remembered current alias + matching enrolled Brews answer** authenticates lost-player-session recovery while eligible. Issue a fresh fixed one-day token and invalidate old token(s)/sockets for that game/alias atomically. Forgotten alias or skipped/forgotten answer has **no recovery fallback or lookup**, including no host override. No Resolved or Cancelled/post-exit recovery. Other games and host authentication remain separate; HLD-066 permits authenticated answer changes/deletion but not alternative proof (Section 9.4).

nodes.label: HLD-032 Final-board History and common three-month TTL
nodes.norm_label: hld-032 final-board history and common three-month ttl
nodes.rationale: From first durable terminal transition (Resolved or In Progress → Cancelled), retain **final ordered announced cards, participating aliases, winning alias and one final board-state snapshot per player for three months**, then automatically delete the entire History. No winner for confirmed manual no-winner end. User explicitly withdrew the earlier one-week player TTL: player alias/board snapshots use the same three-month deadline. Final layout/values/matches only, no intermediate-board history or session/recovery credentials. TTL never extends access; backend expiry/scheduled cleanup must work without visits. Schema/calendar/cleanup/backup mechanics remain LLD (Section 6.3).

nodes.label: HLD-033 Random board generation and position-sensitive uniqueness
nodes.norm_label: hld-033 random board generation and position-sensitive uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Fill non-free cells randomly from the valid game pool without a repeated value within one board. Values may occupy any value-bearing position, without row/column-specific ranges. Boards in one game must have distinct cell-for-cell layouts; the same values in different positions are valid different boards. Regenerate duplicate candidates until valid, but reject Start with an explanation if the configuration cannot produce enough distinct layouts for the start-time players. FREE cells have no pool value (HLD-035). Preserve sufficient-pool validation, backend ownership and persistent identity; HLD-034 fixes generation/assignment timing. Feasibility/randomization/transaction algorithms remain LLD (Sections 2, 4–7, 10; BR-026/BR-029).

nodes.label: HLD-034 Board generation and assignment immediately after host start
nodes.norm_label: hld-034 board generation and assignment immediately after host start
nodes.rationale: Start first rejects with an explanation any configuration unable to produce enough distinct boards; accepted host start immediately triggers backend HLD-033 generation/assignment for the start-time player memberships. No pre-start boards or generation on joining/recovery. Evaluate initial qualification and persist boards/flags before playable delivery/first call; retried start and reconnect preserve committed boards. No new lifecycle state or client authority. Start eligibility remains separate; atomicity/coordination/failure mechanics are LLD (Sections 2, 4–10; BR-026).

nodes.label: HLD-035 Configurable valueless free cells and initial qualification
nodes.norm_label: hld-035 configurable valueless free cells and initial qualification
nodes.rationale: Host checkbox defaults to `true`/checked with one free cell using the same one-based formula for all sizes: `(ceil(height / 2), ceil(width / 2))` (`2 × 2` → `(1,1)`, `5 × 5` → `(3,3)`). Before rules are finalized, host may disable or select locations up to all cells, without a smaller count cap. Free cells have no pool value; sample only non-free cells and validate the distinct pool accordingly. Free cells count as satisfied on assignment; a complete free-cell line immediately flags qualification before calls, but never awards/resolves automatically. Host is responsible for that allowed setup. Reject Start with an explanation when distinct boards cannot be produced, including all-free boards; no duplicate-board exception. Persist free-cell locations/status through recovery and final History. Mechanisms/tests remain LLD (Sections 2, 6.1–6.3, 7, 10; BR-026/BR-029).

nodes.label: HLD-036 Pre-start cancellation permission
nodes.rationale: The designated host may cancel in both New and Awaiting Players (Item 2.1); HLD-037 settles Cancelled as the no-winner terminal outcome (Item 2.2). Item 2.3 requires explicit confirmation in both New and Awaiting Players; dismissing it leaves state/configuration/code/membership unchanged. Item 2.5 requires deletion of game/participant data after cancellation commits. Item 2.6 shows joined players/spectators a cancellation notice with independent exit, not forced redirection. Do not make cleanup wait for notices to be acknowledged or viewers to exit. Safe code reuse remains unanswered; reliable notice/cleanup/retry mechanisms remain LLD. Item 2.4 excludes both New and Awaiting Players cancellations from History; do not generate an empty History entry. No board generation, restart or winner award in Cancelled; In Progress end-confirmation requirement is preserved. No LLD or implementation is authorized (Section 7.7).
nodes.status: Confirmed permission and terminal outcome — remaining behavior open

nodes.label: HLD-037 Winner-only Resolved and no-winner Cancelled terminal states
nodes.norm_label: hld-037 winner-only resolved and no-winner cancelled terminal states
nodes.rationale: Accepted host award commits Resolved; pre-start cancellation and confirmed In Progress no-winner end commit Cancelled. Both terminal states freeze gameplay and do not reopen. Under HLD-077, any terminal transition releases the sole global nonterminal-game reservation after commit; pre-start deletion/History policy, code reuse, notices and independent exits remain unchanged. No auto-ending due to qualification, pool exhaustion, disconnect or session expiry.

nodes.label: HLD-038 Awaiting Players configuration stays fixed
nodes.norm_label: hld-038 awaiting players configuration stays fixed
nodes.rationale: Item 2.7 prohibits Awaiting Players → New or a return to editable game configuration. Resume preserves the same finalized rules/grid/free cells/pool and existing code/membership. To change setup, cancel with confirmation and create a distinct game; do not reset the original or reopen Cancelled. HLD-048 also restricts capacity changes to New. No LLD or implementation is authorized (Sections 2, 5–7, 10).

nodes.label: HLD-039 Former independent saved-unstarted and In-Progress limits
nodes.norm_label: hld-039 former independent saved-unstarted and in-progress limits
nodes.rationale: Historical decision allowed one New/Awaiting Players game plus a separate In Progress game. The user later directed one game total across all nonterminal states. Do not implement/apply these independent allowances; HLD-077 is authoritative.
nodes.status: Superseded by confirmed user revision HLD-077

nodes.label: HLD-040 Two currently connected players required to start
nodes.norm_label: hld-040 two currently connected players required to start
nodes.rationale: Item 3.1 requires at least two distinct currently connected players with valid player sessions/membership at accepted host start. Spectators, disconnected retained memberships and duplicate sockets do not satisfy the minimum. All other joined players need not be connected. Existing HLD-034 assignment to retained start-time player memberships is unchanged. No automatic start or post-start cancellation on attendance loss. Presence/race/detection mechanisms remain LLD; explicit departure remains a separate product review (Sections 2, 7, 8, 10).

nodes.label: HLD-041 Explicit player departure while Awaiting Players
nodes.norm_label: hld-041 explicit player departure while awaiting players
nodes.rationale: Item 3.2 allows explicit player Leave and releases the player slot before start. The departing player no longer counts toward occupancy, connected-player start eligibility or the unstarted roster, and has no board. Temporary disconnect retention remains different. HLD-054 releases the alias, HLD-055 permits fresh pre-start rejoining; exact credential cleanup remains LLD; no capacity-bypassing restoration or post-start new player admission is introduced (Sections 7–10).

nodes.label: HLD-042 Explicit player departure during In Progress
nodes.norm_label: hld-042 explicit player departure during in progress
nodes.rationale: Item 3.3 allows explicit Leave during In Progress and retains that player’s slot and assigned board until game end. No replacement/late player admission or regenerated board; automatic durable matching/History remains unchanged. Item 3.4 allows return during the same In Progress game using a still-valid session or code + remembered current alias + enrolled Brews answer. Restore the retained membership/board; no new slot/player. Item 3.5 keeps departed players eligible for qualification and a host-selected award if their retained board qualifies; current connection/return is not an award prerequisite. The real-life Bingo/alias exchange and one-winner rules remain. Precise credential/socket cleanup and race enforcement are LLD (Sections 7–10).

nodes.label: HLD-043 Disconnected player retention before start
nodes.norm_label: hld-043 disconnected player retention before start
nodes.rationale: Item 3.6 retains the Awaiting Players membership and slot until host start or cancellation unless the player explicitly Leaves. No timed disconnect-based player-seat release; disconnected members do not count toward the two-currently-connected start gate. Start includes retained members in board assignment and continued In Progress retention; pre-start cancellation deletes their data after commit. Fixed one-day sessions/approved recovery and five-minute spectator grace stay separate. Abandoned unstarted whole-game cleanup follows HLD-068; no implementation authorized (Sections 7–10).

nodes.label: HLD-044 Explicit spectator departure releases slot immediately
nodes.norm_label: hld-044 explicit spectator departure releases slot immediately
nodes.rationale: Item 3.7 allows spectator Leave in Awaiting Players/In Progress and immediately releases the spectator slot. Five-minute grace applies only to unintentional disconnect, not deliberate Leave. A later spectator join must obey current lifecycle/capacity; no guaranteed reserved seat, player admission or terminal re-entry. Race/credential/socket cleanup remains LLD; start remains spectator-independent (Sections 7–10).

nodes.label: HLD-045 Bidirectional role switching before start
nodes.norm_label: hld-045 bidirectional role switching before start
nodes.rationale: Item 3.8 permits player ↔ spectator switching during Awaiting Players, bounded by target-role capacity. Player admission needs a valid available alias; no pre-start board. Commit the role/occupancy change consistently and preserve old role/seat on rejection; target player eligibility must not race past start. No In Progress promotion/new player admission. Alias release and answer deletion follow HLD-054/HLD-067; session/credential/transaction mechanics remain LLD (Sections 7–10).

nodes.label: HLD-046 Default player and spectator capacities
nodes.norm_label: hld-046 default player and spectator capacities
nodes.rationale: Items 4.1/4.2 set default per-game limits to **20 players** and **50 spectators**, equal to their independent hard ceilings. Defaults do not authorize higher limits or prove measured capacity. Lower permitted settings, HLD-048 freezes both limits after New; no post-admission reduction is permitted (Sections 6–7, 10).

nodes.label: HLD-047 Allowed configured capacity ranges
nodes.rationale: Items 4.3/4.4 permit every integer player limit from **2 through 20 inclusive**, default 20, and every integer spectator limit from **0 through 50 inclusive**, default 50. Spectator zero disables spectator admission; it neither blocks nor satisfies player start. Reject fractional/out-of-range settings rather than rounding/clamping. No preset-only restriction. HLD-048 restricts changes to New, so post-admission reductions are prohibited; enforcement mechanisms remain LLD (Sections 6–7, 10).

nodes.label: HLD-048 Capacity limits editable only in New
nodes.norm_label: hld-048 capacity limits editable only in new
nodes.rationale: Item 4.5 permits the designated host or an enrolled admin to change player/spectator limits during New, within HLD-047 ranges. Both limits are fixed once Awaiting Players begins and remain fixed during In Progress/terminal states. Other hosts remain read-only. New has no admitted participants, so below-occupancy reduction is not an applicable product action; reject post-New changes rather than evicting participants. Changing a finalized limit requires confirmed cancellation and a distinct new game. Validation/race mechanics remain LLD (Sections 2, 6–7, 9–10).

nodes.label: HLD-049 Case-insensitive per-game alias comparison
nodes.rationale: Item 5.1 makes per-game alias uniqueness case-insensitive: Alice and alice identify the same alias and cannot be separate players in one game. Recovery uses that same comparison, not case-sensitive spelling matching; the enrolled answer remains independently verified. Cross-game alias reuse and maximum 20 characters remain. Character repertoire/whitespace/Unicode/counting and rename/reuse details are reviewed separately; comparison implementation remains LLD (Sections 2, 6–7, 9–10).

nodes.label: HLD-050 ASCII-only player aliases
nodes.rationale: Item 5.2 restricts aliases to ASCII letters (A–Z/a–z), digits (0–9) and printable ASCII punctuation. Reject Unicode/emoji/accented letters and control characters; render punctuation safely as plain text. HLD-051 allows ordinary internal ASCII spaces, preserving repetitions, and trims outer spaces; length is counted after trimming. Maximum 20 characters applies to the accepted alias; ASCII avoids Unicode byte/codepoint/grapheme counting ambiguity. Join, role-switch admission and recovery share character/comparison rules; implementation remains LLD (Sections 2, 6–7, 9–10).

nodes.label: HLD-051 Alias space normalization and length counting
nodes.norm_label: hld-051 alias space normalization and length counting
nodes.rationale: Item 5.3 trims leading/trailing ordinary ASCII spaces but allows and preserves internal spaces, including repeated spaces. Reject an empty/space-only result. Apply the maximum **20 ASCII characters after trimming**, including each retained internal space/punctuation character; never silently truncate or collapse spaces. Uniqueness/recovery compare that trimmed alias case-insensitively under HLD-049. Use identical rules for join, role switching and recovery; Unicode/control characters remain rejected. HLD-052 allows pre-start rename; Item 5.5 uses the current alias after rename; same-game reuse remains a separate decision (Sections 2, 6–7, 9–10).

nodes.label: HLD-052 Player alias changes before start only
nodes.norm_label: hld-052 player alias changes before start only
nodes.rationale: Item 5.4 allows an authenticated player to change their own alias only during Awaiting Players, to a valid available alias under HLD-049–HLD-051. Keep stable membership, player slot and any enrolled recovery verifier; no board is generated, and no change becomes a new player. Reject renaming once In Progress or terminal. Recheck uniqueness/lifecycle consistently and preserve old alias on failure. Item 5.5 requires the remembered **current alias after the most recent rename**, plus game code and the same enrolled Brews answer; the old alias is not an alternate recovery identifier. Item 5.6 releases the old alias immediately for another player; old credentials/answers never transfer to a new claimant; alias/session-binding update must not extend one-day session TTL. Mechanisms remain LLD (Sections 7, 9–10).
nodes.status: Confirmed rename and current-alias recovery — old alias released after rename

nodes.label: HLD-053 Old alias released after successful rename
nodes.norm_label: hld-053 old alias released after successful rename
nodes.rationale: Item 5.6 immediately releases the prior alias after a successful Awaiting Players rename; another player may claim it subject to current admission/capacity rules. Renamed membership retains its stable identity and enrolled answer and uses its current alias for recovery. A reused alias never inherits prior sessions/answers; no identifier-only ownership or token rebinding. Atomic rename/claim/race mechanics remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-054 Alias released on pre-start departure or spectator switch
nodes.norm_label: hld-054 alias released on pre-start departure or spectator switch
nodes.rationale: Item 5.7 releases the player alias immediately on explicit Awaiting Players Leave or accepted player → spectator switch, alongside the player slot. Another eligible player may claim it; earlier sessions/recovery proof never authenticate a new claimant. Failed switch/Leave leaves claims unchanged. Temporarily disconnected players keep their claimed alias/seat under HLD-043; In Progress Leave keeps membership/alias/board under HLD-042. Pre-start rejoining and answer handling on role switches remain separate decisions.

nodes.label: HLD-055 New admission after explicit pre-start player Leave
nodes.norm_label: hld-055 new admission after explicit pre-start player leave
nodes.rationale: Item 5.8 permits a departed Awaiting Players player to join again while that game remains Awaiting Players, using any valid available alias and free player slot. Treat this as fresh admission with optional answer enrollment, never recovery of the removed membership/slot or transfer of old credentials. Their old alias is not guaranteed available. Start winning the admission race rejects the new player; no In Progress new admission.

nodes.label: HLD-056 Game-code alphabet and input handling
nodes.norm_label: hld-056 game-code alphabet and input handling
nodes.rationale: Items 6.1/6.2 generate/display exactly eight characters from uppercase ASCII A–Z and digits 0–9. Submitted codes ignore ASCII letter case and trim outer ordinary ASCII spaces; reject internal spaces, control/non-ASCII characters and any result not exactly eight permitted letters/digits. Normalize to the uppercase code for join/recovery lookup consistently; no silent truncation or fuzzy matching. Code lifetime/reuse remain separate decisions; random generation/collision checks/protocol remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-057 Game-code validity follows nonterminal lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: hld-057 game-code validity follows nonterminal lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Item 6.3 keeps the issued code valid while the game is Awaiting Players or In Progress, without an independent time-based expiry. Enforce existing role/admission/recovery rules. On Resolved/Cancelled, the code stops granting new admission/recovery/re-entry; existing authorized pre-exit final views remain distinct. Session TTL stays fixed at one day. Abandoned-game cleanup may terminate/remove a game only under its separately reviewed policy; old code reuse is fixed by HLD-058.

nodes.label: HLD-058 Code collision/reuse checked against live games and retained History
nodes.norm_label: hld-058 code collision/reuse checked against live games and retained history
nodes.rationale: Items 6.4/6.4a prohibit issuing a code already present in a live/current game or unexpired retained History. Use History’s existing three-month TTL, not a permanent issued-code ledger. Once no live game or retained History contains it, reuse is permitted, including after History expiry or pre-start cancellation/deletion. Code reuse never transfers old sessions, answers, exit state or membership to the new stable game identity; stale credentials fail. Cleanup/issuance races and minimal temporary retry protection remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-060 Confirmed immediate host transfer before/during play
nodes.norm_label: hld-060 confirmed immediate host transfer before/during play
nodes.rationale: Items 7.2/7.2a permit the designated host to transfer in New/Awaiting Players/In Progress to another provisioned host with completed password setup. Show the transferring host a confirmation window identifying the target host. Dismissing it changes nothing; accepted confirmed transfer commits immediately without incoming-host acceptance. At commit, only the target gains host mutation/private-live-board authority and the old host becomes an ordinary read-only host; existing account sessions remain identity credentials, not retained host rights. Preserve game data/code/memberships/boards/calls/reservations. No disconnect takeover or terminal transfer. Reauthorization/race/retry mechanics remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-061 Concurrent host account sessions allowed
nodes.norm_label: hld-061 concurrent host account sessions allowed
nodes.rationale: Item 7.3 allows multiple simultaneous logins for one host account across browsers/devices. Each session retains independent fixed one-day expiry and normal revocation/logout rules; a new login does not revoke older host sessions by default. Game host authority is account-based and rechecked server-side; concurrent actions serialize/deduplicate against current state. Participant one-live-connection/session policy remains distinct, not an account-wide host-login prohibition. No session TTL extension or host duplication.

nodes.label: HLD-062 Read-only private live-board access for all enrolled hosts
nodes.norm_label: hld-062 read-only private live-board access for all enrolled hosts
nodes.rationale: Item 7.4 allows other fully enrolled hosts with valid host sessions to inspect private In Progress player boards and qualification details read-only. The designated host or an enrolled admin may perform valid game mutations (HLD-074). Players see only their own board; spectators no private boards. This permission never includes recovery answers/verifiers/session tokens or participant-session ownership. Role-filtered snapshots/WSS and ongoing expiry/revocation checks must enforce it; implementation remains LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-066 Authenticated player recovery-answer maintenance
nodes.rationale: Item 8.4 allows an owner with a valid player session to set, replace or delete their private Brews recovery answer in Awaiting Players/In Progress. Setting permits enrollment after initial skip; replacement invalidates the prior verifier, and deletion disables answer recovery rather than leaving an empty credential. Preserve membership/alias/board/seat and fixed session expiry. A lost/expired session cannot use this operation or host override to establish ownership; only existing code + current alias + enrolled-answer proof can recover it. Terminal mutation remains prohibited. Normalization, verifier storage, CSRF/abuse/confirmation and transaction mechanics remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-067 Delete player recovery verifier on spectator switch
nodes.norm_label: hld-067 delete player recovery verifier on spectator switch
nodes.rationale: Item 8.5 deletes the player recovery-answer verifier on accepted player → spectator switch in Awaiting Players. Release player alias/slot under HLD-054 and deauthorize prior player-role sessions/proof. A later eligible spectator → player switch enrolls an optional answer afresh with its available alias/seat; never restore a deleted verifier or infer the old alias is available. Spectator answer recovery remains excluded; failed switch preserves existing role and verifier. Exact role/session transaction mechanics remain LLD.

nodes.label: HLD-068 Abandoned unstarted game auto-cancellation
nodes.rationale: Commit Cancelled then delete game/participant data after 24 hours without qualifying designated-host activity while New/Awaiting Players; no History. Release the single global nonterminal-game reservation after required terminal/deletion coordination. Only intentional host open/resume or accepted host action resets the timer; passive traffic does not. This never ends In Progress.

Ordinary hosts, players, spectators and unauthenticated callers are excluded. Enabling is distinct from password reset, does not grant a new role or recreate a deleted account, and must not revive revoked/expired credentials. **Approved enable outcome:** restore the pre-disable lifecycle state: Verified permits a fresh login with the existing password; PendingEnrollment still requires setup; ResetRequired still requires reset. Previously revoked/expired sessions and links stay invalid. Account disablement is derived solely from populated `disabled_at`, retaining lifecycle status without a duplicate boolean or previous-status copy. Set it on disable; clear it on enable; authorized no-op retries leave it unchanged. Disable blocks authentication/enrollment/reset until authorized enable; pending setup/reset uses fresh links from existing flows. DO-022 approves account-wide credential-epoch invalidation rules: credentials bind to and validate against the current account epoch, with no credential revival on enable.
